For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
God is our harbour and our strength, a very present help in trouble.
（可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。）神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是我們在患難中隨時的幫助。
Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
For this cause we will have no fear, even though the earth is changed, and though the mountains are moved in the heart of the sea;
所以，地雖改變，山雖搖動到海心，
though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
Though its waters are sounding and troubled, and though the mountains are shaking with their violent motion. (Selah.)
其中的水雖匉訇翻騰，山雖因海漲而戰抖，我們也不害怕。（細拉）
There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
There is a river whose streams make glad the resting-place of God, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
有一道河，這河的分汊使神的城歡喜；這城就是至高者居住的聖所。
God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
God has taken his place in her; she will not be moved: he will come to her help at the dawn of morning.
神在其中，城必不動搖；到天一亮，神必幫助這城。
Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
The nations were angry, the kingdoms were moved; at the sound of his voice the earth became like wax.
外邦喧嚷，列國動搖；神發聲，地便鎔化。
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！（細拉）
Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
Come, see the works of the Lord, the destruction which he has made in the earth.
你們來看耶和華的作為，看他使地怎樣荒涼。
He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
He puts an end to wars over all the earth; by him the bow is broken, and the spear cut in two, and the carriage burned in the fire.
他止息刀兵，直到地極；他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations, I will be honoured through all the earth.
你們要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！
